subject: Cognitive Science
title: Overconfidence
description: A quick, practical guide to Overconfidence.

hook.text: Ask people: are you an above-average driver? About 80% say yes. Mathematically, they can't all be right.

buildup.text: Overconfidence is one of the most reliable findings in judgment research. It appears in every culture and profession.

discovery.text: It comes in three forms: overestimating your ability, your knowledge, and your precision of forecasts.

twist.text: Experts are often more overconfident than novices. Greater knowledge inflates certainty faster than accuracy.

climax.text: A calibration study found that when doctors were 90% sure of a diagnosis, they were right only 50% of the time.
